text:
Maya: sharing a quick mock — https://Figma.link/minmax-toggle — want takeaways on copy + accessibility for the new min/max toggle + burst affordance. TL;DR: two states (soft-min vs hard-min), burst as ephemeral top-up, cost preview inline. Olivia: nice, the toggle visual is clear. question: can we avoid the word 'burst' in customer-facing copy? it's jargon-y. maybe 'peak boost' or 'temporary capacity'? :thinking_face: Sam: UX nit — the toggle label needs to stay visible when collapsed. currently the icon-only state loses context. also we should show the numeric min/max when you hover or focus (keyboard users). Trent: accessibility: keyboard focus order is wrong. tab goes to SLO slider before the min/max stepper; stepper should be next. also need aria-live region for the cost preview so screen readers get updates when users change values. Arun: cost math note — when user increases max it should show both instantaneous rate and projected hourly cost: e.g., "+2 GPUs ≈ $0.72 / hr". that's better than percent. Olivia: re: 'soft-min' vs 'hard-min' — customers find 'soft' confusing. propose: 'Guaranteed minimum' (hard) and 'Flex min (allow scaling below)' for soft. shorter: 'Guaranteed' / 'Flexible'. Maya: good. copy experiment: primary label = 'Guaranteed min' with tooltip: "This capacity stays reserved even during low traffic." secondary = 'Flexible min' tooltip: "Allows autoscaler to drop below this value to save cost." Sam: UI behavior: if user toggles to 'Guaranteed', the burst CTA should be dimmed? i'm worried about conflicting signals — reserved capacity plus burst could be misread. maybe keep burst but show a short badge "bursts apply on top of guaranteed". Trent: ARIA suggestion (example): ```
Estimated cost: $1.20 / hr
``` That will help screen reader users understand the live cost updates. Arun: implementation tradeoff: aria-live polling every slider move can be noisy. update live region after debounce (300ms) and on blur. Maya: decision needed on keyboard microcopy: stepper +/− buttons show tooltips: 'Decrease min' / 'Increase max' or keep '−' and '+' only? which is better for clarity? Olivia: tooltips + visible labels for mobile. For screen readers rely on aria-labels. Visual-only '+' is fine if there's a textual label nearby. Sam: another flow edge: what happens if user sets min > max accidentally? the UI currently prevents but error message is inline and terse. propose: inline validation: "Guaranteed min cannot exceed Max capacity" with :warning: icon, and auto-swap suggestion: 'Set max to X' button. Maya: love auto-swap suggestion. also want a micro copy variant for the burst CTA: instead of 'Add burst', try 'Top up for peaks' (less technical). Trent: contrast check — the burst pill color fails 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds. need higher contrast and focus ring. Arun: backend note — burst events are billed differently (metered by peak-minute). UX should make billing link clear: small 'i' that opens billing detail modal. DesignBot: accessibility checklist added to the thread: keyboard order, aria-labels for steppers, aria-live for cost, high-contrast burst pill, tooltip content length < 140 chars. Maya: next steps: Maya will update Figma with copy variants (Guaranteed / Flexible), change burst microcopy to 'Top up for peaks', add inline validation with auto-swap suggestion, and add aria-live debounce. I'll post updated frame by EOD. anyone object? Olivia: no objections. +1 on 'Top up for peaks'. Sam: will prototype keyboard focus order and visible value-on-focus by tomorrow. Trent: i'll run the contrast tests and provide exact hex fixes. Arun: i'll add the billing link endpoint and a small API flag to surface "billing_hint" so UI can show the modal. Maya: thanks everyone — will follow up with the updated link when done. :sparkles:
